tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the global catalog for MCP servers, skills, and plugins.

tools.name: get_extension
tools.description: Retrieve full details, versions, and verified publisher claim for a capability.

tools.name: prepare_install
tools.description: Preview an immutable InstallPlan (effects, permissions, requirements) before installing.

tools.name: request_install
tools.description: Execute an installation with a human approval token or active grant.

tools.name: list_installed
tools.description: List all installed capabilities and read-only detected external host tools.

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Search through discovered capabilities and tool functions across installed providers.

tools.name: describe_capability
tools.description: Inspect the input schema, declared effects, and identity binding for a specific capability.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Progressively load complete SKILL.md instruction workflow.

tools.name: read_skill_resource
tools.description: Read bounded supporting file/resource associated with an installed skill.

tools.name: invoke_capability
tools.description: Execute an installed capability tool under strict fail-closed policy evaluation.

tools.name: get_invocation
tools.description: Poll the status and logs of an active asynchronous tool invocation.
